verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms is a payments and marketplace infrastructure service, not an agent or AI application that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The evidence only documents an official Adyen MCP server (docs-14, probe-4). That is the server role, which belongs to a separate story and does not show the product can plug in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
